description: Red Lake Electric / Minnkota demand-response load management: when the co-op switches the heat pump off and the house falls back to propane. Source data is the utility's own ripple log.

panels.title: Heat pump (Dual Heat)
panels.description: Load group 3.09 / DO09-16, the utility's dual-fuel control. CURTAILED means Red Lake has shed the heat pump and the house is on propane. Reads the last known state regardless of the dashboard time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "minnkota")
  |> range(start: -400d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ripple_state" and r._field == "curtailed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.load_group == "3.09" and r.do == "DO13")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: EV charging (Battery Storage)
panels.description: Load group 2.06 / DO09. CURTAILED means the utility is currently outside the off-peak charging window.

panels.title: Collector last run
panels.description: Newest collector_run point. The CronJob runs every 5 minutes; anything older than ~30 minutes means the Home Assistant entities are going unavailable.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "minnkota")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "collector_run" and r._field == "points_written")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000.0}))

panels.title: Heat pump curtailed
panels.description: Total hours the utility held the heat pump off in the selected range. Computed with events.duration over a single collapsed series, so it is exact rather than sampled onto a grid. Full 2025-26 season = 152.8 h.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "minnkota")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ripple_state" and r._field == "curtailed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.load_group == "3.09" and r.do == "DO13")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> reduce(
       identity: {prev: 0, prevT: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, ns: 0},
       fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
         prev: r._value,
         prevT: r._time,
         ns: accumulator.ns + (if accumulator.prev == 1
                then int(v: r._time) - int(v: accumulator.prevT) else 0)}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: float(v: r.ns) / 3600000000000.0}))

panels.title: Shed events
panels.description: Number of times the utility switched the heat pump off in range (0 to 1 transitions). Full 2025-26 season = 32.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "minnkota")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ripple_state" and r._field == "curtailed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.load_group == "3.09" and r.do == "DO13")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> difference(nonNegative: false, columns: ["_value"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> count()

panels.title: Heat pump — load group 3.09 / DO13 (Dual Heat)
panels.description: Red bands are periods the utility had the heat pump switched off, forcing the propane furnace. These are the hours the beestat balance-point panel would otherwise attribute to a thermostat aux lockout. Driven by state TRANSITIONS, not raw rows: the ripple log re-broadcasts unchanged states, and Grafana silently truncates a panel at 1001 points.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "minnkota")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ripple_state" and r._field == "curtailed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.load_group == "3.09" and r.do == "DO13")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "state")
  |> difference(nonNegative: false, columns: ["_value"], keepFirst: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r._value or r._value != 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, "Heat pump": r.state}))

panels.title: EV charging — load group 2.06 / DO09 (Battery Storage)
panels.description: Red bands are periods outside the permitted off-peak charging window. Unlike the heat pump this cycles daily by design. Driven by state transitions: the raw series is 2246 rows over a year, past the 1001-point limit at which Grafana truncates and warns.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "minnkota")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ripple_state" and r._field == "curtailed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.load_group == "2.06" and r.do == "DO09")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "state")
  |> difference(nonNegative: false, columns: ["_value"], keepFirst: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r._value or r._value != 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, "EV charging": r.state}))

panels.title: Heat-pump curtailment by month
panels.description: Hours per month the utility held the heat pump off. Windows are labelled by their START: window() + _start, because labelling by the window stop shifts every bar one month later. Uses a stateful reduce() rather than events.duration(), because Grafana prepends "option v" and Flux then rejects any import.

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "minnkota")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ripple_state" and r._field == "curtailed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.load_group == "3.09" and r.do == "DO13")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> window(every: 1mo)
  |> reduce(
       identity: {prev: 0, prevT: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, ns: 0},
       fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
         prev: r._value,
         prevT: r._time,
         ns: accumulator.ns + (if accumulator.prev == 1
                then int(v: r._time) - int(v: accumulator.prevT) else 0)}))
  |> duplicate(column: "_start", as: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        month: string(v: date.year(t: r._time)) + "-" +
               (if date.month(t: r._time) < 10 then "0" else "") +
               string(v: date.month(t: r._time)),
        hours: float(v: r.ns) / 3600000000000.0}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["month"])

panels.title: Curtailment transitions
panels.description: Every time the heat-pump control changed state in range. Derived from difference() on the archived series, so re-broadcast rows that repeat an unchanged state do not appear.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "minnkota")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ripple_state" and r._field == "curtailed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.load_group == "3.09" and r.do == "DO13")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> difference(nonNegative: false, columns: ["_value"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value != 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        Time: r._time,
        Event: if r._value > 0 then "Shed — propane" else "Restored — heat pump"}))
  |> sort(columns: ["Time"], desc: true)

panels.title: Rows archived per load group (synthetic “Test” group excluded)
panels.description: Sanity check on the archive. The Minnkota API also emits a synthetic load group literally named "Test"; it is filtered out here so it cannot inflate any total. 3.09 is the heat pump, 2.06 is EV charging.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "minnkota")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ripple_state" and r._field == "curtailed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.load_group != "Test")
  |> group(columns: ["load_group"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({load_group: r.load_group, rows: r._value}))
  |> sort(columns: ["load_group"])
